svg.title: Selected uprisings in chronological order
svg.desc: Modern timeline, not to scale: Tamblot in Bohol in 1621; Sumuroy in Palapag, Samar in 1649; Basi in Ilocos in 1807. Order does not establish one coordinated event or prove that each caused the next.
